businesses.business: natural and organic packaged foods and personal care

offering_description.value: Develops and markets natural, organic and plant-based packaged foods, beverages and snacks. Sells mainly to grocery, natural food and mass retailers and foodservice, using contract manufacturers and some own plants.

primary_products.value: baby and kids food and snacks; plant-based beverages; tea; snacks; soups and meal preparation items

customer_segment.value: B2B: grocery chains, natural food stores, mass merchants, club stores, e-commerce retailers, distributors, foodservice

end_markets.value: packaged food; beverages; baby and toddler nutrition; natural and organic grocery

revenue_model.value: product sales: branded packaged foods and beverages sold to retailers and distributors

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: owns natural and organic food brands, sourcing ingredients and using co-packers, sold to retailers and distributors; OEM / manufacturer: operates some own plants making food products from purchased ingredients

geography_served.value: North America: United States and Canada, with some international sales

specialization.value: related lines: natural and organic baby food, snacks, beverages, tea and meal preparation sold to the same retail customers

distribution_channels.value: third-party retail: grocery, natural food, mass, club and drug retailers; distributors / dealers: natural food and foodservice distributors; online: e-commerce retailers and some direct-to-consumer sales

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: food safety and labeling rules from FDA and USDA, organic certification, Health Canada requirements

notes: Portfolio has been narrowing through divestitures, so product mix details may be partly outdated.
